name: actions-runner
summary: GitHub's self-hosted Actions runner on Wolfi, laid out like GitHub's own image (/home/runner, uid 1001) so it drops into ARC scale sets. JavaScript actions run on Wolfi's Node 24 (node20 actions included); the bundled npm and the end-of-life Node 20 are removed. Standalone, it registers from RUNNER_URL and RUNNER_TOKEN. Image only, no chart.

name: activemq
summary: Apache ActiveMQ Classic, the Java message broker (JMS, OpenWire, plus AMQP, STOMP and MQTT connectors) with KahaDB persistence and a web console. Official distribution on a hardened JRE.

name: activemq-artemis
summary: Apache Artemis (formerly ActiveMQ Artemis), the multi-protocol Java message broker (CORE, AMQP, STOMP, MQTT, OpenWire) with a journal store and login required by default. Official distribution on a hardened JRE.

name: adc
summary: ADC (API Declarative CLI), the declarative configuration engine for Apache APISIX and API7 Enterprise. Ships as the required adc-server sidecar of the APISIX Ingress Controller, which drives it over a shared Unix socket, and is also usable standalone to lint, diff, dump and sync APISIX configuration. Built from source as an esbuild bundle on a hardened Wolfi Node 24 rather than the upstream Node SEA release binary, which embeds an unpatched interpreter. Image only, no chart.

name: adminer
summary: vrana's single-file PHP database manager, a web UI for MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, and SQLite, served by a hardened PHP runtime.

name: airflow
summary: Apache Airflow, the programmatic workflow orchestration platform for authoring, scheduling, and monitoring DAGs. Built clean-room from source as a Python venv on Wolfi (python-3.12, official constraints), nonroot on a hardened read-only-rootfs base. Ships the 3.2 line (older lines carry unfixed CVEs in Airflow itself). Runs api-server + scheduler + dag-processor + triggerer (and Celery workers) from one image; needs PostgreSQL (and Redis for CeleryExecutor), provided by the chart.

name: akhq
summary: AKHQ, the web UI for Apache Kafka (topics, messages, consumer groups, schema registry, Kafka Connect, ACLs). The release distribution with 74 library jars swapped to fixed releases, on a Wolfi JRE 25.

name: Alertmanager
summary: Companion to Prometheus that routes, groups, deduplicates, and silences alerts and dispatches them to email, Slack, PagerDuty, and more.

name: ansible
summary: Ansible — agentless IT automation and configuration management (the community `ansible` package plus ansible-core and curated collections) with ssh/git/rsync/sshpass tooling, ready to run playbooks. Built from source into a venv on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base. Image only, no chart.

name: apache-polaris
summary: Apache Polaris, the open REST catalog for Apache Iceberg (Iceberg REST and management APIs, catalog RBAC, credential vending, in-memory or PostgreSQL metastore). The official binary distribution with its admin tool on a Wolfi JRE 21, vulnerable jars swapped or stripped and the Quarkus index rebuilt.

name: apisix
summary: Cloud-native API gateway on OpenResty/LuaJIT with dynamic routing, auth, rate limiting, observability and a 100+ plugin ecosystem. Built from source including api7's apisix-runtime, which rebuilds OpenResty against current OpenSSL rather than upstream's pinned older crypto, plus the admin dashboard SPA that upstream now embeds by commit id instead of releasing separately. Runs file-driven standalone by default, so no etcd is required. Ships no prebuilt wasmtime, so proxy-wasm plugins are unavailable, and omits saml-auth because it statically links a 2019 xmlsec fork our scanner cannot inspect.

name: apisix-ingress-controller
summary: The Apache APISIX Ingress Controller, the Kubernetes operator that drives an APISIX data plane. Reconciles Gateway API resources, native Ingress and APISIX's own CRDs such as ApisixRoute, ApisixUpstream and ApisixPluginConfig into APISIX configuration. Built from the ASF source release; tracks Gateway API 1.6 and needs Kubernetes 1.31 or newer.

name: argo-events
summary: Argo Events, event-driven automation for Kubernetes (EventSources for webhooks, queues, schedules and cloud events; Sensors that trigger workflows, resources and HTTP calls). Built from source with the argo CLI for the argoWorkflow trigger.

name: argo-rollouts
summary: The Argo Rollouts controller, progressive delivery for Kubernetes (canary and blue-green Rollouts, analysis runs, traffic shaping through ingresses and meshes). Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated.

name: argo-workflows
summary: Kubernetes-native workflow engine for orchestrating parallel jobs as DAGs. Ships the workflow-controller, the argo CLI/API server with an embedded React UI, and the argoexec executor the controller injects into every workflow pod, built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: argocd
summary: Argo CD, the CNCF declarative GitOps continuous-delivery controller for Kubernetes. One multi-call binary serves every component (server, repo-server, application-controller, applicationset-controller, commit-server, notifications, cmp-server), selected by argv[0] exactly as upstream does, so the chart picks a role with a single command. Built from source with upstream's own asset pipeline, so the server really serves its React web console instead of 404ing every UI route. Ships git, git-lfs, openssh-client and gnupg for private and signature-verified repos, plus Helm 3 built from source and the Wolfi Kustomize, both of which the repo-server execs by bare name.

name: aspnet
summary: Hardened ASP.NET Core runtime for web apps and APIs, no SDK. Build on the dotnet image, then run here. Lines 8/9/10.
knownIssue: Ships .NET 9 and .NET 10 only. The .NET 8 band is held out: dotnet-8-runtime/aspnet-8-runtime 8.0.127-r0 carries CVE-2026-47304 (Critical) plus three High DoS advisories, all fixed only in 8.0.129-r1, which Wolfi has not packaged (verified against the APKINDEX on 2026-08-27). The band returns as soon as that revision lands.

name: Atlantis
summary: Terraform pull-request automation that runs plan on PRs and apply from PR comments, enforcing reviewed, Git-driven infrastructure changes with state locking.

name: authelia
summary: Open-source authentication and authorization server providing single sign-on and two-factor authentication via a web portal, designed as a companion for reverse proxies. Packaged from Authelia's official prebuilt binary; needs a config plus a SQLite or PostgreSQL storage backend.

name: authentik
summary: Self-hosted identity provider (OIDC, SAML, LDAP, SCIM) with flows, policies, and application/provider management. Built clean-room from source on Wolfi as a four-language image (nodejs web UI, Go server/proxy, Rust worker, Python/Django core via uv) on a hardened nonroot base; FIPS mode is not forced and the license-gated MaxMind GeoIP download is omitted. Needs PostgreSQL and Redis at runtime, provided by the chart.

name: backdrop
summary: Backdrop CMS, the PHP content-management system forked from Drupal 7. The official release zip on a hardened Wolfi php-8.4-fpm + nginx runtime (nonroot, read-only rootfs, supervisord). Its settings.php reads the MySQL or MariaDB connection from BACKDROP_DB_* env vars, so the docroot stays read-only and only files/ (uploads, active config, backups) is writable; the CLI installer sets up the schema. Ships 1.34 and 1.35.

name: backing-image-manager
summary: Longhorn's backing image server, built from the longhorn/backing-image-manager source with qemu-img, losetup and the filesystem tools it calls. longhorn-manager starts it on each node; drop-in for upstream's image, runs as root like upstream.

name: bifrost
summary: AI gateway giving one OpenAI-compatible API over many model providers, with load balancing and failover. Single Go binary with the web console embedded, built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; sqlite is compiled in, so nothing links it at runtime. Image only, no chart.

name: bind
summary: ISC BIND 9, the authoritative and recursive DNS server (9.20 stable line). Wolfi's source-built named, nonroot on port 5353, with a default caching-resolver config for local networks.

name: blackbox-exporter
summary: Prometheus exporter that probes endpoints externally over HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, DNS, and ICMP for black-box uptime and latency monitoring.

name: buildah
summary: Buildah, the daemonless OCI image builder, built from source and run rootless as uid 1001 with crun and fuse-overlayfs, the same setup as the Podman image. Building in a pod needs it privileged. Image only, no chart.

name: buildkit
summary: BuildKit, the concurrent container image build engine behind docker build, as the rootless variant: buildkitd runs under rootlesskit as uid 1001 on Wolfi runc and fuse-overlayfs, with buildctl in the same image. Built from source with its containerd, go-archive and otel modules floated.

name: buildkite-agent
summary: The Buildkite CI build-runner agent that executes pipeline jobs on your own infrastructure. Image only, no chart.

name: bun
summary: Hardened Bun runtime and toolkit (runtime, bundler, package manager) for JavaScript and TypeScript. Latest stable (1).

name: BusyBox
summary: Hardened minimal base/toolbox image bundling common Unix utilities in one binary. Image only, no chart.

name: Caddy
summary: Web server and reverse proxy with fully automatic HTTPS via Let's Encrypt and a simple Caddyfile config.

name: cadence
summary: Fault-tolerant, stateful workflow orchestration engine by Uber. Ships the cadence server and CLI as static Go binaries on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; Cassandra or a SQL store is the operator's concern.

name: cadvisor
summary: Analyzes resource usage and performance characteristics of running containers. Image only, no chart.

name: calico-cni
summary: Calico's CNI plugin, IPAM plugin and install-cni installer with the reference CNI plugins it ships (bandwidth, host-local, loopback, portmap, tuning, flannel), all built from source.

name: calico-csi
summary: Calico's CSI node driver (pod2daemon csidriver), built from source.

name: calico-key-cert-provisioner
summary: Calico's key-cert-provisioner, the init container the Tigera operator adds to request certificates through a CSR; built from source.

name: calico-kube-controllers
summary: Calico's Kubernetes controllers (policy, node, IPAM and service-account sync) with its check-status probe, built from source.

name: calico-node
summary: Project Calico's node agent (Felix, BIRD, confd) for Calico networking and network policy; Go binaries built from source over Wolfi's Calico node package.

name: calico-node-driver-registrar
summary: The CSI node-driver-registrar under the name Calico's operator deploys (calico/node-driver-registrar), built from kubernetes-csi source.

name: calico-pod2daemon-flexvol
summary: Calico's pod2daemon flexvol driver and its host installer, built from source.

name: calico-typha
summary: Calico Typha, the datastore fan-out cache between the Kubernetes API server and every Felix agent, built from source.

name: camel-k
summary: Apache Camel K, the Kubernetes operator that builds and runs Camel integrations (Integration, Pipe and Kamelet CRDs) as native cloud workloads. kamel built from source on Wolfi OpenJDK 17 and Maven 3.9, so integration builds run on a scanned toolchain.

name: Cassandra
summary: Distributed wide-column NoSQL store built for linear horizontal scale and high availability with no single point of failure, tuned for heavy writes.

name: centrifugo
summary: Scalable real-time messaging server (WebSocket, SSE, GRPC) with channels, presence, and JWT auth. Built from source as a static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: ceph
summary: Ceph, the distributed object, block and file store (mon, mgr, osd, mds, radosgw, rbd-mirror, exporter), from Wolfi's ceph-20 (Tentacle) packages without cephadm. Laid out like upstream's image for Rook. Image only; the Rook chart is next.

name: ceph-csi-operator
summary: The Ceph CSI operator, which deploys and configures the Ceph CSI driver and its sidecars from Driver and OperatorConfig resources; Rook 1.21 installs CSI through it. Built from source with its vulnerable modules floated. Image only.

name: cephcsi
summary: The Ceph CSI driver for RBD block, CephFS and NFS volumes, built from source against Wolfi's Ceph 20 libraries with the client tools it runs. Image only; Rook deploys it through the ceph-csi-operator.

name: cert-manager-acmesolver
summary: acmesolver component of cert-manager. The minimal HTTP server cert-manager runs as ephemeral pods to answer ACME http-01 challenge requests during certificate issuance.

name: cert-manager-cainjector
summary: cainjector component of cert-manager. Injects CA bundles into ValidatingWebhookConfigurations, MutatingWebhookConfigurations, APIServices, and conversion CRDs so the rest of the stack trusts cert-manager-issued certificates.

name: cert-manager-controller
summary: Core controller of cert-manager, the CNCF standard for X.509 certificate management on Kubernetes. Reconciles Certificate, Issuer, ClusterIssuer, and ACME order resources, automating issuance and renewal from Let's Encrypt, Vault, Venafi, and self-signed/CA issuers.

name: cert-manager-webhook
summary: Admission webhook component of cert-manager. Validates and mutates cert-manager API resources and serves the conversion webhook for its CRD versions.

name: chartmuseum
summary: Helm chart repository server with support for cloud object storage backends (S3, GCS, Azure, and more).

name: checkov
summary: Checkov, the static analysis scanner for infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, Helm, Dockerfile, CI configs). From PyPI into a Python 3.13 venv, with asteval patched past its pin. Image only, no chart.

name: cilium
summary: The Cilium agent (cilium-agent, cilium-dbg, cilium-health, hubble, the BPF sources, CNI loopback and upstream's init scripts) built from the cilium/cilium source with the same module floats as cilium-operator, on Wolfi's clang/llc, bpftool, iproute2 and iptables. Drop-in for upstream's agent image; runs as root on the node like upstream.

name: cilium-operator
summary: The Cilium Operator, generic variant (cluster-pool IPAM, CRD registration, identity and endpoint garbage collection) for a Cilium install run with its own operator off. Built from the cilium/cilium source with the vulnerable modules floated.

name: clamav
summary: ClamAV antivirus engine built from the release tarball. clamd scans streams over TCP 3310 for apps that check uploads, freshclam keeps the signature database current, and clamscan runs one-off scans. Two lines, 1.5 and the 1.4 LTS.

name: ClickHouse
summary: Column-oriented OLAP database for real-time analytical queries over very large datasets, with high ingest rates and fast aggregations.

name: cloudnative-pg
summary: CloudNativePG, the Kubernetes operator for PostgreSQL high availability: streaming replicas, automated failover, and backups. Built from source (static Go, golang.org/x and otel floated); the same binary is copied into each PostgreSQL pod as its instance manager.

name: cluster-autoscaler
summary: Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler, the SIG Autoscaling controller that adds nodes when pods cannot be scheduled and removes underused ones. Every cloud provider is compiled in (AWS, Azure, GCE, Cluster API, Hetzner, kwok and the rest); same layout as upstream's image, binary at /cluster-autoscaler.

name: CockroachDB
summary: Distributed SQL database with PostgreSQL wire compatibility and automatic horizontal scaling and survivability. BUSL is source-available, not OSI-approved; no clean in-catalog substitute yet, evaluate PostgreSQL for single-region SQL.
cleanAlternative: No in-catalog clean substitute yet — evaluate PostgreSQL for single-region SQL.

name: code-server
summary: VS Code in the browser (Coder's code-server), a full IDE served over HTTP. Ships Coder's official prebuilt release (bundled Node 24 + compiled VS Code) hardened on a minimal, nonroot Wolfi base; runs as a single-replica Deployment with a persistent workspace and PASSWORD login.

name: composer
summary: PHP base image with the Composer dependency manager, used as the build stage for PHP projects. Line 2.

name: concourse
summary: Concourse CI, built from the release tag with its web UI compiled and embedded in the one Go binary, the containerd, grpc and otel modules floated to their fixed releases. The web node (ATC and TSA) runs nonroot on a read-only rootfs against an external PostgreSQL; the worker runs privileged on Wolfi's containerd and runc with the CNI plugins built from source, and bundles the registry-image and time resource types built from their tags. The git resource type is its own image, concourse-git-resource.

name: concourse-git-resource
summary: Concourse's git resource type, the upstream check/in/out scripts on Wolfi git, git-crypt, gnupg and openssh, with git-lfs and proxytunnel built from source. Load it in a pipeline with resource_types (type registry-image); the worker bundles registry-image and time. Image only, no chart.

name: configurable-http-proxy
summary: configurable-http-proxy, the Node.js proxy JupyterHub routes users through, managed over a token-protected REST API. Packaged from npm (production dependencies only) on Wolfi nodejs-24.

name: connaisseur
summary: Connaisseur, the Kubernetes admission controller that verifies container image signatures (Cosign/Sigstore, Notary v1 and v2) against trust roots before a pod is admitted, with per-image policy rules. Serves HTTPS on 5000 with /mutate, /health and /metrics; config and certificates are mounted under /app.

name: contour
summary: Project Contour, the CNCF Kubernetes ingress controller that programs Envoy over xDS. Serves HTTPProxy and Ingress plus Gateway API, and one binary covers every role, including the xDS control plane, Envoy bootstrap generation, certgen, shutdown-manager and the Gateway provisioner. Pairs with the QuenchWorks envoy data plane.

name: Coolify
summary: Control-plane application for Coolify, an open-source self-hostable PaaS alternative to Heroku, Vercel, and Netlify for deploying apps, databases, and services on your own servers.

name: Coolify Helper
summary: Coolify helper image carrying the build and deploy toolchain (buildpacks, git, ssh) that runs on target hosts to execute deployments.

name: Coolify Realtime
summary: Realtime server component of Coolify, providing the websocket connections and terminal/log gateway for the dashboard. Licensed AGPL.
knownIssue: Holds 1 Medium CVE (cloudflared CVE-2026-41178). The fix is cloudflared 2026.6.1-r2, not yet in Wolfi (newest is the vulnerable 2026.5.2-r2), so a rebuild cannot clear it. A new release follows as soon as Wolfi ships the patched cloudflared.

name: coredns
summary: Fast, flexible DNS server that chains plugins to serve DNS and service discovery, the default cluster DNS for Kubernetes.

name: coroot
summary: Coroot — open-source observability/APM (eBPF-based metrics, logs, traces, cost insights and service maps) with an embedded Vue UI. Built from source on Wolfi (go:embedded frontend, cgo lz4), prometheus/ch-go bumped to their fixed lines.

name: cosign
summary: Sigstore's container-signing CLI. Keyless sign and verify of images, SBOMs, and attestations against the Fulcio/Rekor transparency log. Image only, no chart.

name: cosmian-kms
summary: KMIP 2.1 key management server with PKCS#11 and Google/Microsoft CSE support -- the only KMIP speaker in this catalog. Shipped under BUSL-1.1, which is NOT OSI-approved AND caps production use at 2 vCPUs (1 physical core) while barring third-party offering; read the licence before deploying. Built non-FIPS against Wolfi's OpenSSL, so it is NOT FIPS 140-3 validated despite upstream's description.

name: CouchDB
summary: Document database with an HTTP/JSON API and multi-master replication, designed for offline-first sync across nodes and devices.

name: crane
summary: crane, the go-containerregistry CLI for working with images and registries directly (copy, digest, append, export, mutate, catalog). From Wolfi's source-built apk. Image only, no chart.

name: cratedb
summary: CrateDB, the distributed SQL database for time series, logs and full-text search (PostgreSQL wire protocol plus an HTTP SQL endpoint, on Lucene). Official tarball on a hardened Java 25 JRE instead of its bundled JDK, with its vulnerable jackson and log4j jars replaced.

name: crossplane
summary: Crossplane, the CNCF control-plane framework that turns Kubernetes into a universal API for infrastructure. Installs Providers, Functions and Configurations as OCI packages, and lets platform teams publish their own composite APIs from CompositeResourceDefinitions and Compositions.

name: csi-attacher
summary: The Kubernetes CSI external-attacher sidecar, which attaches and detaches CSI volumes through VolumeAttachment objects. Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated, for any CSI driver (Longhorn included). Image only, no chart; runs as root like upstream.

name: csi-livenessprobe
summary: The Kubernetes CSI livenessprobe sidecar, which serves /healthz by probing a CSI driver socket. Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated, for any CSI driver (Longhorn included). Image only, no chart; runs as root like upstream.

name: csi-node-driver-registrar
summary: The Kubernetes CSI node-driver-registrar sidecar, which registers a node CSI driver with the kubelet (busybox included for driver preStop hooks). Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated, for any CSI driver (Longhorn included). Image only, no chart; runs as root like upstream.

name: csi-provisioner
summary: The Kubernetes CSI external-provisioner sidecar, which creates and deletes CSI volumes for PersistentVolumeClaims. Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated, for any CSI driver (Longhorn included). Image only, no chart; runs as root like upstream.

name: csi-resizer
summary: The Kubernetes CSI external-resizer sidecar, which expands CSI volumes when a PersistentVolumeClaim grows. Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated, for any CSI driver (Longhorn included). Image only, no chart; runs as root like upstream.

name: csi-snapshotter
summary: The Kubernetes CSI external-snapshotter sidecar, which creates and deletes CSI snapshots for VolumeSnapshotContent objects. Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated, for any CSI driver (Longhorn included). Image only, no chart; runs as root like upstream.

name: dagster
summary: Dagster, the asset-oriented data orchestrator for ML and analytics pipelines. dagster, dagster-webserver, dagster-graphql and dagster-postgres from PyPI in a Python 3.13 venv on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; one image runs the webserver (UI on 3000), the daemon and user-code servers.

name: dapr
summary: Dapr, the distributed application runtime - the daprd sidecar with building-block APIs (state, pub/sub, bindings, actors, workflows) and its control plane (operator, placement, sentry, injector, scheduler) in one image. Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated.

name: datahub-frontend
summary: DataHub frontend, the Play server for the DataHub React UI, login and GraphQL proxy. Upstream's release taken by digest and repackaged on a Wolfi JRE 25 with fixed jars; ships no default login (the chart provides the admin credential).

name: datahub-gms
summary: DataHub GMS, the metadata service of the DataHub data catalog: REST, OpenAPI and GraphQL APIs with the Kafka consumers embedded. Upstream's release war taken by digest and repackaged on a Wolfi JRE 25, with the vulnerable jars swapped and the jackson copies inside hazelcast and auth-api rebuilt from fixed releases.

name: datahub-upgrade
summary: DataHub upgrade job, whose SystemUpdate task creates the SQL table, Kafka topics and search indices a fresh DataHub install needs. Upstream's release jar taken by digest and repackaged on a Wolfi JRE 25 with fixed jars, including the jackson copies bundled in hazelcast, parquet and auth-api.

name: deno
summary: Hardened Deno runtime for JavaScript and TypeScript, secure by default with explicit permissions and built-in tooling. Frozen at 2.9.7 since 2026-10-14, when the Deno team announced it is joining Cloudflare and the runtime gets only a final year of bug-fix and security releases.

name: dependency-track
summary: OWASP Dependency-Track API server, the SBOM analysis platform that tracks components across projects and flags known vulnerabilities, outdated and license-risky dependencies. Official dist on a hardened Java 25 JRE, with its vulnerable freemarker jar replaced. Needs PostgreSQL.

name: dependency-track-frontend
summary: The OWASP Dependency-Track web UI, the official release bundle served by a nonroot, read-only-rootfs nginx with a conf.d hook for proxying /api to the API server. Image only; the dependency-track chart deploys it.

name: descheduler
summary: Kubernetes descheduler that evicts pods so the scheduler can re-place them for better cluster balance. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: dex
summary: Federated OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider. Acts as a portal to other identity providers (LDAP, SAML, GitHub, Google, OIDC) and issues OIDC tokens to apps and Kubernetes.

name: distribution
summary: The CNCF reference OCI and Docker registry server for storing and distributing container images and other OCI artifacts.

name: dive
summary: dive, the explorer for container image layers: shows each layer's files and the space wasted across them, and gates image efficiency in CI with --ci. Built from the release tag as one static binary, nonroot. Image only, no chart.

name: DocumentDB
summary: Self-contained MongoDB-compatible server bundling PostgreSQL, the DocumentDB extension, and a wire gateway. Linux Foundation project, truly open under MIT.

name: dotnet
summary: Hardened .NET SDK for building and running .NET apps. Use as a build base; ships the current LTS line (10). Image only, no chart.

name: dotnet-runtime
summary: Hardened .NET runtime for console and worker apps, no SDK. Build on the dotnet image, then run here. Lines 8/9/10.
knownIssue: Ships .NET 9 and .NET 10 only. The .NET 8 band is held out: dotnet-8-runtime/aspnet-8-runtime 8.0.127-r0 carries CVE-2026-47304 (Critical) plus three High DoS advisories, all fixed only in 8.0.129-r1, which Wolfi has not packaged (verified against the APKINDEX on 2026-08-27). The band returns as soon as that revision lands.

name: Dragonfly
summary: Multi-threaded, Redis- and Memcached-compatible in-memory datastore built to scale vertically on one node. BUSL is source-available, not open source; prefer Valkey (BSD-3-Clause).

name: drupal
summary: Drupal core, the open-source CMS and content framework. Built from the official release tarball on a hardened Wolfi php-8.4-fpm + nginx runtime (nonroot, read-only rootfs, supervisord); the chart supplies settings.php via ConfigMap and a MySQL backend. Ships the 11.3/11.4 lines (11.2 is held because drupal/core-recommended pins guzzle below its CVE fix).

name: duckdb
summary: In-process analytical SQL database CLI, shipped from upstream's official precompiled binary. Image only, no chart.

name: easegress
summary: Easegress, the Go traffic orchestration gateway (HTTP/1-3 proxy, filters and pipelines, embedded etcd for clustering), with the egctl admin client. Built from source with its stale dependency set (opa, quic-go, pgx, jwt, chi) floated.

name: Elasticsearch
summary: Distributed search and analytics engine. Shipped under SSPL/Elastic License, which are not OSI-approved; OpenSearch (Apache-2.0) is the open drop-in fork.
cleanAlternative: OpenSearch (Apache-2.0) — the open drop-in fork of Elasticsearch.

name: elixir
summary: Hardened Elixir runtime on the BEAM VM, built on Erlang/OTP, for concurrent, fault-tolerant apps (e.g. Phoenix). Latest stable (1.18).

name: emissary
summary: Emissary-ingress, the CNCF Kubernetes API gateway built on Envoy (Mapping, Host and Listener CRDs, auth, rate limiting, canaries). Envoy 1.37 from Wolfi, the Python control plane (diagd) and the Go busyambassador built from source; upstream layout and uid 8888. Pairs with emissary-apiext.

name: emissary-apiext
summary: Emissary-ingress apiext, the conversion webhook that serves the getambassador.io CRD versions (v2 and v3alpha1) and patches the CRDs with its CA. Part of Emissary-ingress; upstream layout, uid 8888.

name: emqx
summary: Massively scalable, distributed MQTT broker for IoT, IIoT, and connected vehicles. Speaks MQTT 5.0 over TCP/TLS/websockets with a clustering engine and a web dashboard. Packaged from EMQX's official Erlang/OTP release. Licensed BSL 1.1 (single node free; clustering requires a commercial license).

name: envoy
summary: Cloud-native L7 proxy and communication bus, the data plane behind API gateways and service meshes. HTTP/gRPC routing, load balancing, rich observability, and an admin/health endpoint. The chart supplies the bootstrap config.

name: envoy-gateway
summary: Gateway API control plane from the Envoy project. Watches Gateway, HTTPRoute and its own policy CRDs and programs Envoy over xDS, provisioning and managing the proxy fleet. Drives the QuenchWorks envoy image as its data plane. Ships two minor lines because 1.7.x carries a docker/docker advisory whose stated fix version has no corresponding Go module.

name: erlang
summary: Hardened Erlang/OTP runtime on the BEAM VM, built for highly concurrent, fault-tolerant systems. Latest stable lines (27/28/29).

name: etcd
summary: Distributed, strongly consistent key-value store using Raft consensus. The backing store for Kubernetes and a building block for service coordination and config.

name: excalidraw
summary: Open-source virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn-style diagrams. Self-hostable as a static SPA served by hardened nginx, with no backend or account required.

name: external-dns
summary: Synchronizes Kubernetes Services and Ingresses with DNS providers so records are managed automatically.

name: external-secrets
summary: External Secrets Operator, the CNCF operator that syncs secrets from external APIs (AWS/GCP/Azure Secrets Manager, Vault, and many more) into Kubernetes Secrets. The single controller binary also serves the webhook and cert-controller, with every provider compiled in.

name: fabric-orderer
summary: Hyperledger Fabric orderer, the ordering service node that sequences transactions into blocks over Raft (and BFT on 3.x) and serves the channel participation API. Built from source for the 2.5 LTS and 3.1 lines, sampleconfig at /etc/hyperledger/fabric. Image only, no chart.

name: fabric-peer
summary: Hyperledger Fabric peer, the permissioned-blockchain node that holds the ledger and world state, endorses transactions and runs chaincode (with the chaincode-as-a-service builder). Built from source for the 2.5 LTS and 3.1 lines, sampleconfig at /etc/hyperledger/fabric. Image only, no chart.

name: falco
summary: Falco runtime threat detection, built from source with falcosecurity/libs and the modern eBPF probe against Wolfi system libraries (OpenSSL, zlib, curl), plus the container plugin built from source with its Go modules floated. Runs privileged as root on every node. Image only, no chart.

name: FerretDB
summary: MongoDB-compatible document database that translates the MongoDB wire protocol onto PostgreSQL via the DocumentDB extension. The clean-license substitute for MongoDB.

name: filebrowser
summary: Web-based file manager with a built-in UI, users, and share links. From source (Vite UI embedded in a static Go binary) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; data and served roots are volumes.

name: flink
summary: Apache Flink, the stateful stream and batch processing engine. Upstream's official binary distribution on a hardened nonroot Wolfi JRE 21, with the log4j2 jars moved to their fixed release; one image runs the jobmanager, taskmanager, standalone-job or history-server role and takes config from FLINK_PROPERTIES.

name: floci
summary: Local AWS cloud emulator and LocalStack Community successor, built from source into a Quarkus fast-jar on a hardened Wolfi JRE. The hardened image runs all 55 of Floci's in-process AWS services nonroot with no Docker socket, covering S3, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, SES, IAM, STS, KMS, Secrets Manager, API Gateway, Cognito, Kinesis, CloudFormation, Step Functions, EventBridge, CloudWatch, Route53, and more. The 10 Docker-backed services (Lambda, RDS, ElastiCache, MSK, ECS, EKS, OpenSearch, ECR, DocumentDB, Neptune) need the host Docker socket plus root and are out of scope for this image.

name: floci-full
summary: Opt-in, NON-hardened companion to the floci image: it runs as root and expects the host Docker socket mounted, which lets it emulate all 65 of Floci's AWS services including the 10 Docker-backed ones (Lambda, RDS, ElastiCache, MSK, ECS, EKS, OpenSearch, ECR, DocumentDB, Neptune). Same from-source Quarkus build and 0-CVE Trivy gate as floci, but running root with a mounted /var/run/docker.sock is a node-root / container-escape surface, so use it only in trusted single-tenant dev or CI. The floci Helm chart selects this image via mode=full behind an explicit acknowledgeRisk gate. Image only, no separate chart.

name: Fluent Bit
summary: Lightweight, fast log and metrics processor and forwarder for collecting, filtering, and shipping telemetry to many backends.

name: fluentd
summary: Fluentd, the CNCF unified logging layer that collects, parses, buffers and routes logs (forward, HTTP and tail inputs; stdout and file outputs built in, plugins as gems). Built on Wolfi Ruby 4.0 with its native extensions compiled.

name: flux-helm-controller
summary: Flux helm-controller, the GitOps controller that reconciles HelmReleases (install, upgrade, test and roll back Helm charts). Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated. Image only; the flux chart deploys it.

name: flux-image-automation-controller
summary: Flux image-automation-controller, the GitOps controller that updates YAML in a Git repository when new container images match an ImagePolicy, and pushes the commit. Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated. Image only.

name: flux-image-reflector-controller
summary: Flux image-reflector-controller, the GitOps controller that scans container image repositories and reflects their tags as ImageRepository and ImagePolicy objects, which drive image automation. Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated. Image only.

name: flux-kustomize-controller
summary: Flux kustomize-controller, the GitOps controller that builds Kustomizations from source artifacts and applies them, with SOPS decryption and health checks. Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated. Image only; the flux chart deploys it.

name: flux-notification-controller
summary: Flux notification-controller, the GitOps controller that sends Flux events to chat and incident tools and receives webhooks that trigger reconciliation. Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated. Image only; the flux chart deploys it.

name: flux-source-controller
summary: Flux source-controller, the GitOps controller that fetches Git repositories, Helm charts, OCI artifacts and buckets and serves them as artifacts. Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated. Image only; the flux chart deploys it.

name: flux-source-watcher
summary: Flux source-watcher, the GitOps controller that composes and decorates source artifacts with ArtifactGenerator objects, producing new artifacts from one or more sources. Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated. Image only.

name: flyway
summary: Flyway Community, versioned SQL database migrations for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite and more. The release's Java tree on a Wolfi JRE 21 with two bundled JDBC drivers swapped to fixed releases. Image only, no chart.

name: forgejo
summary: Self-hosted lightweight Git forge (a community Gitea fork) with issues, PRs, CI, and packages. From source with the web UI embedded (no Node at runtime), CGO+static-musl SQLite, on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; data lives on a writable volume.

name: friendica
summary: Friendica, the federated social network server (ActivityPub, Diaspora, OStatus). The official friendica-full release on a hardened Wolfi php-8.3-fpm + nginx runtime (nonroot, read-only rootfs, supervisord) with the background worker daemon built in. Vendored PHP libraries and browser assets are floated to fixed releases. The installer writes local.config.php to a mounted config directory and the schema to an external MariaDB or MySQL. Ships the newest release.

name: frr
summary: FRRouting, the routing protocol suite (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, BFD, PIM), from Wolfi's frr package. Runs as root like upstream's image, with upstream's docker-start entrypoint and /etc/frr layout. Image only, no chart.

name: fulcio
summary: Fulcio, the Sigstore certificate authority: it issues short-lived code-signing certificates bound to OIDC identities, for keyless signing with cosign. Built from source; file, KMS, Tink and Google CA backends (not PKCS#11).

name: Garage
summary: Lightweight, S3-compatible object store for small, self-hosted, geo-distributed deployments that stays available across node failures. Licensed AGPL; runs well on modest hardware.

name: ghost
summary: Open-source Node.js publishing platform for blogs, newsletters, and membership sites. Packaged from Ghost's official npm distribution on a hardened Wolfi Node 22; configured entirely via environment and backed by an external MySQL/MariaDB with a content PVC for themes, images, and data.

name: Gitea
summary: Lightweight self-hosted Git service with repositories, issues, pull requests, and built-in CI/CD (Actions). A low-footprint GitHub alternative.

name: gitlab-runner
summary: GitLab Runner, the agent that runs GitLab CI jobs, here for the Kubernetes executor. Built from source (static Go, golang.org/x and otel floated) with upstream's version stamps, so executors pull the matching helper image.

name: gitleaks
summary: Gitleaks, the secret scanner for git history, directories and stdin. Built from source (static Go) with the git client included for history scans. Image only, no chart.

name: gitness
summary: Self-hosted Git forge with built-in CI/CD pipelines (harness/gitness, open-source edition). Go backend with the React web UI compiled in via go:embed, CGO SQLite by default, nonroot on a hardened Wolfi base. Image only, no chart.

name: go
summary: Hardened Go toolchain for compiling binaries in a build stage; pair the output with the static base for the runtime. Latest 3 stable lines (1.24/1.25/1.26).

name: gogs
summary: Gogs, the painless self-hosted Git service (repositories, issues, pull requests, wikis, webhooks, built-in SSH). Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated; SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL.

name: gotify
summary: Self-hosted server for sending and receiving real-time push messages over WebSocket, with a web UI and app tokens. From source (UI embedded, CGO+static-musl SQLite) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; data on a writable volume.

name: gradle
summary: JDK base image with Gradle, used as the build stage for Gradle projects; run the resulting jar on jre. Line 9.

name: Grafana
summary: Dashboards and visualization for metrics, logs, and traces across many data sources. OSS edition, licensed AGPL.

name: grafana-alloy
summary: OpenTelemetry Collector distribution that collects, transforms, and ships logs, metrics, traces, and profiles, configured in Grafana's Alloy syntax. Image only, no chart.

name: gravitee-console
summary: Gravitee APIM console, the Angular admin UI for designing, deploying and securing APIs. The static bundle from the APIM full distribution served by the Wolfi nginx, nonroot, on 8080.

name: gravitee-gateway
summary: Gravitee API Management (APIM) community gateway: v2 and v4 HTTP and TCP proxy APIs with plans, API keys, JWT and OAuth2, rate limits and 80+ policies. From the APIM full distribution on a Wolfi openjdk-21-jre, nonroot, traffic on 8082 and node API on 18082. Only the Apache-2.0 community plugins ship: the Enterprise plugins (Kafka, MQTT, message entrypoints, AI and MCP proxies) are removed at build time.

name: gravitee-management-api
summary: Gravitee APIM management API, the REST API behind the console and the developer portal, on MongoDB or JDBC (PostgreSQL, MariaDB). From the APIM full distribution on a Wolfi openjdk-21-jre, nonroot, API on 8083 and node API on 18083, community plugins only.

name: graylog
summary: Graylog, the log-management and analysis server (search, dashboards, alerting, GELF/Beats inputs). Built clean-room on a hardened Wolfi JRE (nonroot, read-only rootfs); the chart provides MongoDB (metadata) and OpenSearch (log storage) backends. Graylog Server is SSPL-1.0 (source-available, not OSI-approved).

name: grist
summary: Grist, the self-hosted spreadsheet-database (Airtable alternative) with Python formulas. The tagged source compiled with yarn and pinned production deps on Node 22 (8484); formulas run in the gVisor sandbox (runsc built from source with an unprivileged-mode port, so the pod needs no extra privileges). Data in /persist (SQLite home DB and documents).

name: grype
summary: Anchore's vulnerability scanner for container images and filesystems, driven by the same SBOM engine as Syft. Image only, no chart.

name: guacamole
summary: Apache Guacamole, clientless remote desktop in the browser for RDP, VNC, SSH and telnet hosts, as the web app (pair it with guacd). Assembled from Apache's release artifacts on Tomcat 9 and Wolfi openjdk-21 with the PostgreSQL auth extension; logback and jackson swapped to fixed versions inside the WAR. Configured through environment variables.

name: guacd
summary: guacd, the Apache Guacamole proxy daemon behind clientless browser access to RDP, VNC, SSH and telnet hosts. Built from source against Wolfi FreeRDP 2 (the upstream image's default; 1.6.0 does not build on FreeRDP 3.32), libvncserver, libssh2 and libtelnet. The Kubernetes-exec protocol is left out.

name: hadolint
summary: Dockerfile linter. Checks Dockerfiles against best-practice rules and runs ShellCheck on every RUN instruction; pipe a Dockerfile in with "-". Image only, no chart.

name: HAProxy
summary: High-performance TCP and HTTP load balancer and reverse proxy known for reliability and fine-grained traffic control at scale.

name: Harbor core
summary: Core API server and control plane of the Harbor container registry, handling auth, projects, policies, and orchestration.

name: Harbor exporter
summary: Prometheus exporter that exposes Harbor registry health and usage metrics for monitoring.

name: Harbor jobservice
summary: Harbor's asynchronous job runner that executes replication, garbage collection, and image-scan tasks in the background.

name: Harbor portal
summary: Web UI for the Harbor container registry, serving the management dashboard for projects, repositories, and scan results.

name: Harbor registry
summary: OCI registry storage backend (Docker distribution) that stores and serves image layers and manifests for Harbor.

name: Harbor registryctl
summary: Harbor registry controller that manages garbage collection and registry storage lifecycle operations alongside the registry backend.

name: Harbor trivy-adapter
summary: Harbor vulnerability-scan adapter backed by Trivy, scanning pushed images for CVEs and reporting results into Harbor.

name: hasura
summary: Hasura GraphQL Engine, an instant GraphQL API with permissions over PostgreSQL. The Apache-2.0 Community Edition server and console, taken by digest from upstream's -ce images and repackaged on Wolfi; telemetry off.

name: headscale
summary: Open-source, self-hosted implementation of the Tailscale control server for coordinating a WireGuard mesh. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; config and state on writable volumes.

name: homepage
summary: Homepage, a services and bookmarks dashboard with live widgets for hundreds of self-hosted apps. A Next.js app built from source into its standalone bundle on Node 22. Configured with YAML files; can discover services from Kubernetes Ingresses.

name: httpd
summary: Apache HTTP Server, the long-standing open-source web server and reverse proxy for serving static content and fronting application backends (mod_proxy).

name: hubble-relay
summary: Hubble Relay, Cilium's cluster-wide aggregator of Hubble network-flow observability (one Observer API across every node). Built from the cilium/cilium source with the vulnerable modules floated.

name: hubble-ui
summary: Hubble UI, Cilium's web UI for the service map and live network flows. The React frontend built from source and served by a Wolfi nginx that proxies the API to hubble-ui-backend in the same pod.

name: hubble-ui-backend
summary: The Hubble UI backend, the Go service that reads flows and the service map from Hubble Relay and streams them to the Hubble UI. Built from source. Image only, the hubble-ui chart runs it.

name: hydra
summary: Ory Hydra, an OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect provider. Issues and validates tokens for first- and third-party clients without owning user credentials -- it delegates login and consent to an external identity provider, so it pairs with Kratos rather than replacing it.

name: InfluxDB
summary: Time-series database purpose-built for ingesting and querying metrics, events, and IoT/sensor data at high write rates.

name: ingress-nginx
summary: The Kubernetes NGINX Ingress Controller. Routes external HTTP/HTTPS traffic to in-cluster Services via Ingress resources, with TLS termination, path/host routing, and an admission webhook. The chart wires its RBAC, IngressClass, and webhook.

name: istio-cni
summary: Istio's CNI node agent (upstream install-cni) with the istio-cni plugin, built from source from the same istio/istio tags as istiod, plus Wolfi iptables (legacy and nft) for ambient-mode redirection. A privileged node agent by design.

name: istio-proxyv2
summary: Istio's sidecar and gateway data plane. pilot-agent built from the istio/istio source, paired with Istio's own Envoy (the Wolfi istio-envoy build at the exact istio/proxy commit the release pins), laid out like the upstream proxyv2 image. Ships 1.31. Image only, no chart.

name: istiod
summary: Istio's control plane binary (pilot-discovery) -- Pilot/xDS discovery, the sidecar-injecting webhook, and the mesh CA -- built from source on Wolfi. Ships three minor lines in parallel (1.28/1.29/1.30). Boots against a baked-in, unreachable kubeconfig for the standalone smoke test; a real deployment points it at a live cluster via the chart.

name: jaeger
summary: Distributed tracing platform (Jaeger v2, OpenTelemetry-collector based) with an embedded query UI. From source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; in-memory storage by default, badger under a volume.

name: jdk
summary: Hardened OpenJDK with the javac compiler, a build-stage base image to FROM for Java apps. LTS lines 17/21/25.

name: jenkins
summary: The leading open-source automation server for building, testing, and deploying software, with thousands of plugins. Ships the architecture-independent jenkins.war LTS line on a hardened Wolfi JRE.

name: jenkins-inbound-agent
summary: Jenkins inbound (JNLP/websocket) build agent — the remoting agent.jar plus launch script on a hardened Wolfi JRE, connecting back to a Jenkins controller to run builds. Image only, no chart.

name: jetty
summary: Eclipse Jetty, the lightweight Java web server and servlet container (Jakarta EE 10 on 12.0, EE 11 on 12.1), from the official jetty-home distribution on a hardened JRE, with a ready JETTY_BASE that deploys web apps from webapps/.

name: jmeter
summary: Apache JMeter load-testing and performance-measurement tool, the official binary distribution running on a hardened Wolfi JRE. Image only, no chart.

name: joomla
summary: Joomla, the PHP content-management system. The official Full_Package release on a hardened Wolfi php-8.3-fpm + nginx runtime (nonroot, read-only rootfs, supervisord). The image ships no configuration.php; it is read from a mounted config directory, and the CLI installer, the web installer's replacement, writes the schema to an external MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL. Ships 5.4, 6.1 and 6.2.

name: jre
summary: Hardened Java runtime (JRE) for running a built jar, no compiler. Pair with the jdk, maven, or gradle build image. LTS lines 17/21/25.

name: jupyterhub
summary: JupyterHub, the multi-user server that gives each user their own Jupyter notebook server, here as the hub with KubeSpawner (notebooks as pods) and OAuthenticator (GitHub, GitLab, Google, generic OIDC). Packaged from PyPI on Wolfi python-3.13; pairs with configurable-http-proxy.

name: k6
summary: Developer-friendly load and performance testing tool scripted in JavaScript. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; test scripts are mounted at runtime.

name: Kafka
summary: Distributed event-streaming platform for high-throughput, durable, replayable publish-subscribe pipelines and stream processing.

name: kafka-exporter
summary: kafka_exporter, the Prometheus exporter for Kafka brokers, topics, partitions and consumer-group lag. Built from the release tag as one static binary, nonroot, metrics on 9308.

name: karapace
summary: Karapace, Aiven's Kafka schema registry (Avro, JSON Schema, Protobuf) and REST proxy, both Confluent-API compatible. From the tagged source into a Python 3.13 venv, with the Go extension's modules floated; one image runs either role.

name: keda
summary: Kubernetes event-driven autoscaler that scales workloads based on external event sources (queues, streams, metrics). Ships the operator and metrics adapter as static Go binaries on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: Keycloak
summary: Open-source identity and access management server providing SSO, user federation, and OAuth2/OIDC and SAML for apps and APIs.

name: kfp-api-server
summary: The Kubeflow Pipelines API server, which stores pipelines, runs, experiments and recurring runs in MySQL and compiles each run to an Argo Workflow. Built from source, linking Wolfi's SQLite instead of a vendored copy.

name: kfp-driver
summary: The Kubeflow Pipelines v2 driver, the step Argo runs before every task to resolve inputs, check the cache and record executions in ML Metadata. Built from source.

name: kfp-frontend
summary: The Kubeflow Pipelines UI, the React client and the Node server that serves it and proxies the API server, artifacts and pod logs. Built from source with its npm dependencies pinned to fixed releases.

name: kfp-launcher
summary: The Kubeflow Pipelines v2 launcher, a static binary copied into every task container that runs the user command and moves input and output artifacts through the object store. Built from source.

name: kfp-persistence-agent
summary: The Kubeflow Pipelines persistence agent, which watches Argo Workflows and ScheduledWorkflows and reports run state back to the API server. Built from source.

name: kfp-scheduled-workflow-controller
summary: The Kubeflow Pipelines ScheduledWorkflow controller, which starts recurring and cron-scheduled pipeline runs. Built from source.

name: kgateway
summary: kgateway, the CNCF Gateway API control plane that succeeded Gloo Edge. Watches Gateway, HTTPRoute, GRPCRoute and its own gateway.kgateway.dev policy CRDs, programs Envoy over xDS and provisions the proxy fleet itself. Pairs with the QuenchWorks kgateway-envoy data plane. Ships two minor lines because 2.2.x pins its amd64 data plane to a vendor fork of Envoy this catalog does not rebuild. Carries the Wolfi envoy binary for the strict xDS validation path.

name: kgateway-envoy
summary: The kgateway data plane, upstream's envoy-wrapper rebuilt clean-room: the QuenchWorks hardened Wolfi Envoy binary plus kgateway's own envoyinit shim, which expands Kubernetes Downward API templates in the bootstrap the controller generates and then execs Envoy. Versioned in lockstep with the kgateway control plane. Not a general-purpose Envoy image -- use the envoy image for that.

name: ko
summary: ko, the builder that turns Go applications into container images with no Dockerfile. Built from the release tag as one static binary, shipped with Wolfi's go toolchain and git so `ko build` works inside the image, nonroot. Image only, no chart.

name: kong
summary: API gateway and ingress controller on a patched OpenResty, with routing, auth, rate limiting, and a plugin ecosystem. Built from source against current OpenSSL rather than Kong's pinned older crypto; ships the Admin API without the Kong Manager GUI, whose assets are not built from source upstream.

name: krakend
summary: Stateless, declarative API gateway that aggregates and transforms backend responses from a single JSON config. Built from the community distribution's own target, so the Lua, CEL, martian, JWT/JOSE, CORS, rate-limiting and telemetry middleware are compiled in, and ships a minimal bootable config so the image starts standalone. CGO is off, which trades external plugin loading for a hardened nonroot base.

name: kratos
summary: Ory Kratos, an identity and user-management server covering registration, login, MFA, account recovery and profile self-service. Headless by design -- it ships flows and APIs, not a UI -- and pairs with Hydra when OAuth2/OIDC issuance is also needed.

name: kserve-controller
summary: The KServe controller manager, which turns InferenceService resources into model-serving Deployments with autoscaling and canary rollouts. Built from source; 0.21.0 only.

name: kube-state-metrics
summary: Exposes the state of Kubernetes objects as Prometheus metrics for dashboards and alerts.

name: kube-vip
summary: kube-vip, virtual IPs and load balancing for the Kubernetes control plane and for Services of type LoadBalancer, by ARP or BGP. Built from the release tag as one static binary, nonroot by default; the chart adds the network capabilities.

name: kubectl
summary: Hardened kubectl image with the common cluster toolbelt (helm, kustomize, jq, a busybox shell) — the 0-CVE answer to alpine/k8s and bitnami/kubectl for CI jobs and in-cluster tooling. Image only, no chart.

name: kuberay
summary: KubeRay, the operator that runs Ray clusters, jobs and services on Kubernetes (RayCluster, RayJob, RayService). Built from source, static Go (upstream's strictfipsruntime tag is a no-op on standard Go), with golang.org/x and otel floated on the older lines.

name: kubescape
summary: Kubescape CLI, the Kubernetes security scanner for posture (NSA-CISA, MITRE, CIS frameworks), misconfigurations and image vulnerabilities, against a live cluster or manifests. Built from source. Image only, no chart.

name: kubescape-node-agent
summary: Kubescape's node agent, an eBPF DaemonSet that profiles workload behaviour and detects runtime threats on each node. Built from source.

name: kubescape-operator
summary: Kubescape's in-cluster operator, which schedules and triggers configuration and vulnerability scans for the other Kubescape components. Built from source.

name: kubescape-storage
summary: Kubescape's storage, an aggregated Kubernetes API server that holds scan results, SBOMs and application profiles. Built from source.

name: kubescape-synchronizer
summary: Kubescape's synchronizer, which keeps Kubernetes objects and scan results in sync between the cluster and a backend. Built from source.

name: kubevuln
summary: Kubescape's image vulnerability scanner service (kubevuln), which builds SBOMs of running images and matches them against vulnerability data. Built from source.

name: kubo
summary: Kubo, the reference IPFS node, for content-addressed storage and retrieval (RPC API, HTTP gateway, libp2p swarm over TCP and QUIC). Built from source with the libp2p transport modules floated.

name: kuma
summary: CNCF service mesh control plane (Envoy-based) for multi-zone and multi-cluster meshes. Ships kuma-cp and kumactl with an embedded GUI, built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; default in-memory store runs standalone.

name: kured
summary: kured, the Kubernetes reboot daemon: it watches each node for a reboot-required sentinel and reboots nodes one at a time behind a lock, draining them first. Built from the release tag as one static binary, with nsenter for reaching the host; metrics on 8080.

name: kvrocks
summary: Apache Kvrocks, a distributed key-value database on RocksDB that speaks the Redis protocol, keeping data on disk instead of in RAM. Built from source (clang, OpenSSL) with its bundled C/C++ dependencies checked by version.

name: kyverno
summary: Kubernetes-native policy engine for validating, mutating, and generating resources with no new language. Ships the controllers and CLI as static Go binaries on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: label-studio
summary: Label Studio, the open-source data labeling tool for text, images, audio, video and time series, with a web UI and a token-authenticated REST API. Packaged from PyPI on Wolfi python-3.13; runs on SQLite by default or PostgreSQL. The SDK's brush-to-COCO export is not included (it needs a bundled OpenCV).

name: linkerd-cni
summary: Linkerd's CNI plugin (the alternative to the proxy-init init container), its installer and the Rust cni-repair-controller, built from source from the linkerd/linkerd2-proxy-init cni-plugin tag with upstream's image layout, so the linkerd2-cni chart runs it unchanged. A privileged node agent by design.

name: linkerd-control-plane
summary: Linkerd's control plane `controller` binary (destination, identity, proxy-injector, sp-validator, service-mirror, heartbeat -- one binary, role chosen by subcommand), built from source on Wolfi. Tracks Linkerd's edge-YY.M.P releases -- linkerd/linkerd2 has cut only edge builds since stable-2.14.10 (2024-02-20), Buoyant gates true "stable" builds commercially. Ships the newest patch of the last 3 edge year.month lines (26.6/26.7/26.8). Boots against a baked-in, unreachable kubeconfig for the standalone smoke test; a real deployment points it at a live cluster via the chart.

name: linkerd-extension-init
summary: Linkerd extension-init, the Job the Linkerd Viz chart runs to label its namespace (extension and pod-security labels), built from source in Rust from the linkerd/linkerd-extension-init release tag the viz chart pins.

name: linkerd-policy-controller
summary: Linkerd's Rust policy controller (policy-controller), serving Linkerd's authorization-policy CRDs to the proxy data plane over gRPC. Built from source from the same linkerd/linkerd2 monorepo tag as linkerd-control-plane; uses rustls + aws-lc-rs (an ordinary, Cargo.lock-pinned Rust dependency, not a vendored fixed-version OpenSSL download). Image only, no chart (ships as a container in the control plane's destination Deployment).

name: linkerd-proxy
summary: linkerd2-proxy, Linkerd's Rust data-plane sidecar (mTLS termination and meshed traffic routing) -- a from-scratch Rust proxy with no bundled C++ engine, unlike Istio's Envoy fork, so it is genuinely buildable from source here. Built from linkerd/linkerd2-proxy, a separate repo/release cadence version-paired to each linkerd-control-plane release via upstream's own .proxy-version pin. Image only, no chart (ships inside meshed pods via the injector, not deployed standalone).

name: linkerd-viz-metrics-api
summary: Linkerd Viz metrics-api, the Prometheus-backed stats API behind the Viz dashboard and linkerd viz stat, built from source from the same linkerd/linkerd2 edge tags as linkerd-control-plane.

name: linkerd-viz-tap
summary: Linkerd Viz tap, the tap API server and (with the injector argument) the tap-injector webhook the Viz chart runs from the same image, built from source from the same linkerd/linkerd2 edge tags as linkerd-control-plane.

name: litellm
summary: LiteLLM proxy, one OpenAI-compatible API to call, route, budget and log 100+ LLM providers. MIT build from PyPI in a Python 3.13 venv on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base, serving on 4000; the proprietary litellm-enterprise package is excluded and the build fails if it appears.

name: litestream
summary: Streaming replication for SQLite databases to object storage such as S3, GCS, and Azure. Image only, no chart.

name: livekit
summary: WebRTC SFU server for scalable real-time audio, video, and data. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; config via mounted YAML or LIVEKIT_ env.

name: Loki
summary: Horizontally scalable log aggregation system from Grafana that indexes only labels, not full log text. Like Prometheus, but for logs. Licensed AGPL.

name: longhorn-engine
summary: The Longhorn v1 data engine image, built from source. It carries the static longhorn binary (with libqcow) that the engine-image DaemonSet installs on each node, tgt with Longhorn's backing store, sg_raw and longhorn-instance-manager, at the native commits Longhorn pins per release. Drop-in for upstream's image, runs as root like upstream.

name: longhorn-instance-manager
summary: Longhorn's instance manager, which runs engine and replica processes on each node, built from source with tgt, liblonghorn, libqcow and sg_raw at the commits Longhorn pins per release. V1 data engine only (the default); the SPDK-based v2 engine is not built into this image yet. Drop-in for upstream's image, runs as root like upstream.

name: longhorn-manager
summary: The Longhorn manager (control plane DaemonSet, CSI driver and REST API) built from the longhorn/longhorn-manager source, with the launch-manager and nsmounter scripts and the host tools upstream ships (nfs, cifs, e2fsprogs, xfsprogs, nsenter). Drop-in for upstream's manager image under upstream's Longhorn chart; runs as root like upstream.

name: longhorn-share-manager
summary: Longhorn's share manager, which serves ReadWriteMany volumes over NFSv4. The Go daemon and Longhorn's nfs-ganesha fork (with its longhorn recovery backend) are built from source at the commits Longhorn pins per release. Drop-in for upstream's image, runs as root like upstream.

name: longhorn-ui
summary: The Longhorn web UI, a webpack bundle built from source on Node 20 with its bundled axios, lodash, immutable, d3-color, follow-redirects and form-data moved to fixed releases, served by nginx with upstream's launcher and /v1 proxy to longhorn-manager. Drop-in for upstream's image, uid 499 like upstream.

name: mailpit
summary: Email and SMTP testing tool with a web UI for capturing and inspecting messages during development.

name: MariaDB
summary: Community-developed relational database and drop-in MySQL successor, GPL-licensed and fully open. Default MySQL-compatible engine for the catalog.

name: mariadb-operator
summary: MariaDB Operator, which runs MariaDB and Galera clusters on Kubernetes from CRDs: provisioning, replication and multi-primary HA, backups, users and grants. Built from source; the same binary serves the controller, webhook and the init, agent and backup containers.

name: mastodon
summary: Mastodon, the federated social network server (web and sidekiq). Built from the release tag on a hardened Wolfi ruby-4.0 runtime with every gem compiled from source against Wolfi's libvips, libpq, ICU and libxml2, and the web assets compiled at build time, so no Node ships at runtime. Nonroot, read-only rootfs; PostgreSQL and Redis are external. The streaming server is a separate image.

name: mastodon-streaming
summary: The Mastodon streaming API server (Node), the companion to the mastodon image, on a hardened Wolfi nodejs-24 runtime with only the streaming workspace's production dependencies. Nonroot, read-only rootfs. Image only, no chart; the mastodon chart deploys it.

name: matomo
summary: Matomo, the self-hosted web analytics platform and a privacy-respecting alternative to Google Analytics: you keep the raw data. Built from the official release tarball on a hardened Wolfi php-8.3-fpm runtime fronted by nginx built from source (nonroot, read-only rootfs, supervisord), with the vendored twig/twig replaced by 3.28.0 to clear 14 advisories the shipped 3.11.3 carries. The tarball ships no composer.lock, so the recipe re-materialises the dependency inventory from vendor/composer/installed.php purely so scanners can enumerate what is vendored.

name: mattermost
summary: Open-source, self-hosted team messaging and collaboration platform (a Slack alternative) with channels, direct messages, file sharing, and integrations. Packaged from Mattermost's official Team Edition server release; requires an external PostgreSQL.

name: maven
summary: JDK base image with Apache Maven, used as the build stage for Maven projects; run the resulting jar on jre. Line 3.9.

name: mediamtx
summary: Real-time media server and proxy for RTSP, RTMP, HLS, WebRTC, and SRT. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; config via a mounted mediamtx.yml.

name: mediawiki
summary: MediaWiki, the wiki engine behind Wikipedia. The official release on a hardened Wolfi php-8.3-fpm + nginx runtime (nonroot, read-only rootfs), with the vendored guzzle and webauthn libraries floated to their fixed releases by a targeted composer update. Ships 1.43 LTS and the supported stable lines. The chart installs the schema on first start, into SQLite by default or an external MySQL or PostgreSQL.

name: Meilisearch
summary: Fast, typo-tolerant full-text search engine with an instant-search API, easy to embed for site and in-app search with relevant results out of the box.

name: Memcached
summary: Simple, high-performance distributed in-memory cache for storing small objects and database query results to reduce backend load.

name: metabase
summary: Metabase open-source edition, self-service BI and dashboards over PostgreSQL, MySQL and many other databases. The official uberjar on Java 25, with lz4-java swapped to a fixed release inside the jar. Its own application database is H2 by default, or PostgreSQL.

name: metallb-controller
summary: MetalLB controller, the cluster-wide half of the bare-metal LoadBalancer. Assigns Service IPs from IPAddressPool CRDs and serves the CRD validation webhook. Built from source as a single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; pairs with metallb-speaker in the metallb chart.

name: metallb-speaker
summary: MetalLB speaker, the per-node half of the bare-metal LoadBalancer. Announces assigned Service IPs over L2 (ARP/NDP) or BGP using the native implementation (FRR mode is not included). Built from source as a single static Go binary on a hardened Wolfi base; the chart runs it with NET_RAW for L2. Image only, no chart of its own; it ships in the metallb chart.

name: metrics-server
summary: Kubernetes Metrics Server, the cluster-wide aggregator of resource usage that backs `kubectl top` and the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler. Scrapes kubelet summary endpoints and serves the metrics.k8s.io API through the aggregation layer; it is a short-term metrics source, not a monitoring backend.

name: mimir
summary: Horizontally scalable, highly available long-term storage for Prometheus metrics. Single static Go binary (all-in-one or microservices target) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; object storage is the operator's choice.

name: miniflux
summary: Minimalist, opinionated RSS and Atom feed reader with a clean web UI and a REST API. Single pure-Go static binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; needs PostgreSQL at runtime (operator-provided).

name: mlflow
summary: MLflow Tracking Server for the ML lifecycle — experiment tracking, model registry, and run metadata over a REST/UI on port 5000. Packaged as the lightweight mlflow-skinny stack (gunicorn + psycopg2 + boto3) on a hardened Wolfi python base; needs an external PostgreSQL backend store and an artifact store (S3 or PVC).

name: mongo-express
summary: Mongo Express, the web admin UI for MongoDB and MongoDB-compatible servers such as FerretDB. The tagged source with its webpack UI bundle and pinned yarn production deps on Node 24 (8081); set ME_CONFIG_MONGODB_URL plus session and cookie secrets.

name: MongoDB
summary: Document (NoSQL) database for JSON-like data. SSPL is not OSI-approved / source-available, not open source; prefer the clean alternative FerretDB or DocumentDB.
cleanAlternative: FerretDB + DocumentDB — MongoDB-wire-compatible and truly open (Apache-2.0 / PostgreSQL).

name: mongodb-exporter
summary: Prometheus exporter that collects MongoDB diagnostic data, replica-set status, and collection statistics and exposes them as metrics for monitoring.

name: mosquitto
summary: Lightweight Eclipse MQTT broker for IoT and pub/sub messaging. Speaks MQTT 3.1/3.1.1/5.0 over TCP, TLS, and websockets; built from source with OpenSSL and a hardened nonroot, read-only-rootfs runtime.

name: MySQL
summary: Widely used open-source relational database for general-purpose OLTP workloads, with broad framework and tooling support.

name: mysqld-exporter
summary: Prometheus exporter that collects MySQL and MariaDB server status, InnoDB, replication, and query statistics and exposes them as metrics for monitoring.

name: n8n
summary: Fair-code workflow automation platform — build integrations and automations across 400+ apps via a visual node editor, with native AI/LLM agent nodes. Node build on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; the flagged transitive npm CVE class is cleared image-side with pinned overrides.

name: n8n-runners
summary: n8n external task-runner sidecar — isolates and executes workflow code (JS/Python) out of the main n8n process for security and scale. Built from source on Wolfi. Image only, no chart.

name: NATS
summary: Lightweight, high-performance messaging system for cloud-native pub/sub and request-reply, with optional JetStream persistence and streaming.

name: nats-server-config-reloader
summary: The NATS config reloader sidecar (nats-io/nack), which signals nats-server to reload when its config changes. Built from source. Image only, no chart; the argo-events chart runs it in JetStream EventBus pods.

name: navidrome
summary: Self-hosted music server and streamer compatible with the Subsonic/OpenSubsonic API, with a modern web UI. From source (React UI embedded, CGO+static-musl SQLite) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; music and data on writable volumes.

name: Neo4j
summary: Graph database for highly connected data, queried with Cypher for traversals and relationship-heavy workloads. Community edition is GPLv3.

name: nessie
summary: Project Nessie, the transactional catalog for data lakehouse tables (Git-like branches and commits over Iceberg, plus the Iceberg REST catalog). The official Quarkus uber-jar on a Wolfi JRE 21.

name: netdata
summary: Per-second infrastructure and application monitoring agent with a REST API and Prometheus export; headless build without the Cloud UI.

name: nextcloud
summary: Nextcloud, the self-hosted file-sync and content-collaboration platform. Reconstructed clean-room on a hardened Wolfi php-8.4-fpm + nginx runtime (nonroot, read-only rootfs); the chart installs via occ and provides a MariaDB backend. Nextcloud is AGPL-3.0-only (strong copyleft).

name: nginx
summary: High-performance web server, reverse proxy, and load balancer for serving static content and fronting application backends.

name: nginx-gateway-fabric
summary: NGINX Gateway Fabric control plane: the F5/NGINX Gateway API implementation. Watches GatewayClass, Gateway, HTTPRoute and its own gateway.nginx.org policy CRDs, provisions an nginx Deployment per Gateway, and pushes generated config to the nginx-agent inside it over gRPC. One binary covers three roles the chart uses -- controller, generate-certs, and the initialize step that runs as the init container of every data-plane pod. Pairs with the nginx-gateway-fabric-nginx data plane, which it version-locks to itself.

name: nginx-gateway-fabric-nginx
summary: NGINX Gateway Fabric data plane: nginx built from source with the njs dynamic module, NGF's own njs scripts and base configs, and nginx-agent v3 alongside it in one container. NGF 2.x configures nginx over an agent gRPC stream rather than a ConfigMap, so the hardened quench nginx image cannot serve this role -- it has no njs module and no agent. Provisioned by the nginx-gateway-fabric control plane, never installed on its own. Image only, no chart.

name: nifi
summary: Apache NiFi, the visual dataflow engine for routing, transforming and moving data between systems. Assembled from Apache's binary distribution on Wolfi openjdk-21 (118 NARs, verified 0-CVE with every NAR unpacked): the Hazelcast cache services NAR is removed and the aws NAR's wire jars move to 6.4.5.

name: node
summary: Hardened Node.js runtime with npm, a 0-CVE signed nonroot base image for JavaScript apps. Active LTS lines (20/22/24).

name: node-exporter
summary: Prometheus exporter for host-level hardware and OS metrics (CPU, memory, disk, network) on Linux machines.

name: notation
summary: Notation, the Notary Project CLI to sign and verify container images and OCI artifacts against trust policies. Built from source (static Go). Image only, no chart.

name: nsq
summary: Realtime distributed messaging platform. Ships nsqd, nsqlookupd, and nsqadmin as static Go binaries on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; nsqd data path is a writable volume.

name: ntfy
summary: Simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service for sending push notifications to phones and desktops from any script. From source with the web UI embedded (no Node at runtime) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: oauth2-proxy
summary: Reverse-proxy authentication layer that secures upstream apps by delegating sign-in to OIDC and OAuth2 providers.

name: odoo
summary: Odoo Community Edition, the Python ERP and business apps suite (CRM, sales, inventory, accounting, website) backed by PostgreSQL. Built from the nightly source on Wolfi Python 3.13 with its dependencies at their newest releases and the native ones taken from Wolfi. PDF reports need wkhtmltopdf, which is not included.

name: ollama
summary: Local LLM runtime that pulls, runs, and serves open models (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, and more) behind a simple REST API. CPU-only image; the chart mounts a writable volume for the model store.

name: opa
summary: Open Policy Agent, the CNCF general-purpose policy engine. Evaluates Rego policies over JSON and YAML to enforce authorization, admission control, and configuration rules across the stack.

name: opa-gatekeeper
summary: OPA Gatekeeper, the Kubernetes admission controller for Rego policies (ConstraintTemplates and Constraints, validating and mutating webhooks, audit of existing resources). Built from source with the vulnerable modules floated.

name: OpenBao
summary: Open-source secrets and encryption management for tokens, keys, and certificates, with dynamic secrets and leasing. The Linux Foundation MPL-2.0 community fork of HashiCorp Vault.

name: opencost
summary: Kubernetes cost monitoring and allocation (CNCF). Serves the cost-model API on 9003 as a single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base, with the cloud pricing configs installed where the binary resolves them by default.

name: openfga
summary: Fine-grained authorization engine (Zanzibar-style relationship-based access control) over HTTP and gRPC. From source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; datastore is the operator's choice.

name: openldap
summary: OpenLDAP slapd, the reference open-source LDAP directory server, with the LMDB (back-mdb) backend and the client tools. Runs nonroot on unprivileged ports 1389/1636 and backs directory-driven auth for the identity stack.

name: openresty
summary: OpenResty, nginx with LuaJIT and the lua-nginx-module set for scriptable proxies and web apps. Built from source on Wolfi against the system OpenSSL, PCRE2 and zlib, shell-free, nonroot, read-only rootfs. Server blocks go in /etc/nginx/conf.d.

name: openscap
summary: OpenSCAP, the SCAP compliance scanner (oscap for XCCDF and OVAL evaluation, datastream validation and reports), with the scap-security-guide content, from Wolfi's packages. Image only, no chart.

name: OpenSearch
summary: Search and analytics suite with a Kibana-style dashboards UI. The Apache-2.0 community fork of Elasticsearch and the recommended open alternative.

name: opensearch-dashboards
summary: The web UI for OpenSearch, for search, dashboards and visualizations. Ships without the security plugins, matching the opensearch image.

name: openssl
summary: OpenSSL command-line tool with a busybox shell, for init containers and jobs that convert or inspect certificates (PEM to PKCS12 keystores, s_client checks). Image only, no chart.

name: OpenTelemetry Collector
summary: OpenTelemetry Collector that receives, processes, and exports traces, metrics, and logs, a vendor-neutral pipeline for telemetry routing.

name: opentelemetry-operator
summary: The OpenTelemetry Operator, which manages OpenTelemetry Collectors (deployment, daemonset, statefulset or sidecar), the target allocator and auto-instrumentation injection. Built from source with its default component versions stamped in.

name: opentofu
summary: Open-source, community-governed fork of Terraform, an infrastructure-as-code CLI. Image only, no chart.

name: oras
summary: ORAS, the CLI that pushes and pulls arbitrary artifacts (SBOMs, signatures, Helm charts, any file) to and from OCI registries. Built from source (static Go). Image only, no chart.

name: orientdb
summary: Multi-model database with graph, document and key-value models, queried with an SQL dialect over a binary protocol and an HTTP API. Standalone only, no distributed mode.

name: ory-hydra
summary: Ory Hydra, the OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect provider. Built from source like upstream's Linux release (cgo, sqlite, hsm, json1); one binary serves the public (4444) and admin (4445) APIs and runs migrations and the admin CLI.

name: percona-xtradb-cluster-operator
summary: The Percona Operator for MySQL based on Percona XtraDB Cluster: synchronous multi-primary Galera clusters with HAProxy or ProxySQL, backups and point-in-time recovery, managed through CRDs. Built from source; it deploys Percona's database images.

name: perl
summary: Hardened Perl interpreter for scripts, text processing, and tooling. A base image to FROM for Perl workloads. Latest stable (5).

name: perses
summary: CNCF dashboards and observability visualization tool with an embedded React UI and 24 default panel/datasource plugins. From source (Node UI build embedded in a static Go binary) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: pgadmin
summary: pgAdmin 4, the web administration and development UI for PostgreSQL (query tool, ERD, schema diff, backup and restore). The official wheel under gunicorn on Wolfi Python 3.13, with its native dependencies taken from Wolfi instead of self-bundling wheels.

name: pgbouncer
summary: Lightweight connection pooler for PostgreSQL that fronts thousands of client connections with a small backend pool, cutting per-connection overhead.

name: pgpool
summary: PostgreSQL connection pooler, load balancer and query router. Pools client connections, spreads read-only queries across streaming-replication standbys, and detaches a backend that fails its health check.

name: php
summary: Hardened PHP CLI with common extensions, a base image to FROM for PHP apps. Latest 3 stable lines (8.3/8.4/8.5).

name: phpmyadmin
summary: phpMyAdmin, the web console for MySQL and MariaDB.
