Built from the official release tarball on a hardened Wolfi php-8.3-fpm + nginx runtime (nonroot, read-only rootfs, supervisord), with the stale vendored composer deps (twig, symfony/cache, symfony/process, sodium_compat) re-resolved to their fixed releases and the bundled js-cookie prototype-pollution hole patched. Stateless — the chart is a Deployment that supplies config.inc.php via a ConfigMap, keeps the blowfish_secret across upgrades, and can bundle MariaDB.

name: pinniped
summary: Pinniped, identity services for Kubernetes (the Concierge federates cluster login to an OIDC or LDAP provider, the Supervisor is an OIDC issuer across clusters), with the pinniped CLI. Built from source; latest only.

name: plone
summary: Plone, the enterprise CMS on Zope; this is the Plone 6 backend (Products.CMFPlone with the plone.restapi REST API) that a Volto frontend talks to. Installed from PyPI pinned by the release constraints file on Wolfi Python 3.13 under waitress, native dependencies built from source. Data in ZODB FileStorage on a volume, or RelStorage on PostgreSQL; the site is created on first boot.

name: pnpm
summary: Node base image with pnpm preinstalled via corepack, used as the build stage for pnpm projects. Lines 10/11.

name: pocketbase
summary: Open-source backend in a single file with an embedded SQLite database, auth, file storage, realtime subscriptions, and an admin dashboard over a REST API. Pure-Go static binary (UI embedded) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; state on a writable volume.

name: podman
summary: Podman, the daemonless container engine with a Docker-compatible CLI, built from source and run rootless as uid 1001 with crun, conmon, netavark and fuse-overlayfs. Running containers inside needs a privileged pod; rootless networking is not available (no passt on Wolfi). Image only, no chart.

name: poetry
summary: Python base image with Poetry for dependency management and packaging, used as the build stage for Python projects. Line 2.

name: polaris
summary: Fairwinds Polaris, the Kubernetes configuration validator. Audits running workloads or YAML files against best-practice checks (security contexts, probes, resources, image tags) from the CLI, a web dashboard on 8080 with /results.json, or an admission webhook.

name: policy-reporter
summary: Policy Reporter, Kyverno's PolicyReport aggregator. Watches PolicyReport results from Kyverno and other engines, serves them over a REST API and Prometheus metrics, and pushes new violations to Slack, Loki, Elasticsearch, webhooks and more. Go from the tagged source with its sqlite store.

name: postgres-exporter
summary: Prometheus exporter that collects PostgreSQL activity, replication, and performance stats and exposes them as metrics for monitoring.

name: PostgreSQL
summary: Advanced open-source relational database (v18.x) with strong SQL, ACID transactions, JSON, and a rich extension ecosystem. Ships pgvector for vector similarity search. The catalog's default SQL engine.

name: PostgreSQL + DocumentDB
summary: PostgreSQL 17 plus the open DocumentDB extension, providing BSON document storage and queries. The storage backend that powers FerretDB v2.

name: PostgreSQL 15
summary: PostgreSQL 15.x build for the Coolify wave, which pins PG 15 (the default postgresql image tracks 18.x). Same hardened build with bundled contrib extensions.

name: postgrest
summary: REST API server that serves a RESTful API directly from a PostgreSQL schema. Shipped as upstream's official prebuilt static binary.

name: powerdns
summary: PowerDNS Authoritative Server, built from the release tarball. Serves zones from LMDB by default, which needs no schema and supports DNSSEC and zone creation over the HTTP API, with the gsqlite3, gpgsql, gmysql and bind backends compiled in. Listens on 5353 as nonroot.

name: powerdns-recursor
summary: PowerDNS Recursor, the caching DNS resolver, built from the release tarball. Serves resolution to RFC 1918 and CGN clients by default (never an open resolver), with DNS over TLS to upstreams and Lua scripting. Listens on 5353 as nonroot.

name: prefect
summary: Prefect, the Python-native workflow orchestration server for data pipelines. prefect from PyPI in a Python 3.13 venv on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; the default command runs the server (API and UI on 4200), and the same image runs workers and flow code.

name: Prometheus
summary: Metrics collection, storage, and alerting system that scrapes targets and runs PromQL queries. The de-facto cloud-native monitoring TSDB.

name: prometheus-nats-exporter
summary: The Prometheus exporter for NATS server and JetStream metrics. Built from source. Also runs in the argo-events chart JetStream EventBus pods.

name: proxysql
summary: MySQL-protocol proxy that pools connections, splits reads from writes, routes queries by rule, and fails over between backends. Configured through its admin SQL interface on 6032; clients connect on 6033. The chart supplies backends, users and a remote admin account.

name: Pulsar
summary: Cloud-native distributed messaging and streaming platform with multi-tenancy, geo-replication, and tiered storage that separates compute from storage.

name: pulumi
summary: Infrastructure-as-code CLI for managing cloud resources with general-purpose programming languages. Image only, no chart.

name: pyroscope
summary: Continuous profiling database for analyzing CPU, memory, and other resource usage over time. From source with the React UI embedded (no Node at runtime) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: python
summary: Hardened CPython interpreter with pip, a 0-CVE signed nonroot base image to FROM for Python apps. Ships the latest 3 stable minors (no :latest).

name: Qdrant
summary: Vector database and similarity-search engine for AI embeddings, powering semantic search, recommendations, and RAG with filtered nearest-neighbor queries.

name: questdb
summary: High-performance time-series SQL database for fast ingestion and queries over metrics, financial ticks, and IoT data, with PostgreSQL-wire and InfluxDB line-protocol ingestion.

name: quickwit
summary: Cloud-native search engine for logs, traces, and analytics with sub-second search over object storage. Built from Rust source (UI embedded, no Node at runtime) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; index data on object storage or a writable volume.

name: RabbitMQ
summary: Reliable message broker speaking AMQP plus MQTT and STOMP, with flexible routing, queues, and acknowledgements for decoupling services.

name: rclone
summary: Command-line program to sync files and directories to and from dozens of cloud storage providers. Image only, no chart.

name: Redis
summary: In-memory key-value store used as a cache, message broker, and ephemeral datastore. Shipped under AGPL (not permissive); Valkey is the BSD-licensed open alternative.

name: redis-exporter
summary: Prometheus exporter that scrapes Redis and Valkey runtime stats and exposes them as metrics for dashboards and alerts.

name: redmine
summary: Redmine, the Ruby on Rails project management and issue tracker (issues, wikis, time tracking, Gantt, repositories, REST API) backed by PostgreSQL. Built from the release tarball on Wolfi Ruby 4.0 with every gem compiled from source against the system libxml2, libxslt and libpq. Thumbnails need ImageMagick, which is not included.

name: rekor-tiles
summary: Rekor v2, the Sigstore transparency log, rebuilt on Trillian Tessera tiles: it needs no Trillian or MySQL. Built from source with the POSIX storage backend, where the tile directory is the read API.

name: reloader
summary: Stakater Reloader, the Kubernetes controller that rolls Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets when a ConfigMap or Secret they use changes. Built from the release tag as one static binary, nonroot, metrics and probes on 9090.

name: renovate
summary: Automated dependency-update CLI that opens PRs to keep dependencies current, on a hardened Wolfi Node runtime. Image only, no chart.

name: rethinkdb
summary: RethinkDB, the realtime document database with changefeeds that push query results to clients as data changes, plus a web admin UI. From Wolfi's source-built apk, run as uid 1001 with data in /data.

name: rook
summary: The Rook Ceph operator, which runs Ceph clusters on Kubernetes (block, object and file storage through CRDs). Built from source with its vulnerable modules floated, on the same Ceph 20 packages as the ceph image.

name: rqlite
summary: Lightweight, distributed relational database built on SQLite and Raft. Ships rqlited and the rqlite CLI as static (musl) Go binaries on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; data dir is a writable volume.

name: ruby
summary: Hardened Ruby interpreter with Bundler, a base image to FROM for Ruby apps. Latest 3 stable lines (3.2/3.3/3.4).

name: rust
summary: Hardened Rust toolchain (cargo plus rustc) for build stages; ship the compiled binary on the static base. Latest 3 stable lines (1.94/1.95/1.96).

name: RustFS
summary: S3-compatible, high-performance object store written in Rust with a zero-master architecture, positioned as an Apache-2.0 MinIO alternative. Beta/preview.

name: satosa
summary: SATOSA, the IdentityPython proxy that translates between SAML2 and OpenID Connect or OAuth2, so services and identity providers that speak different protocols can federate. The official wheel under gunicorn on Wolfi Python 3.13, with xmlsec1 for SAML signatures and native dependencies built from source.

name: ScyllaDB
summary: High-throughput, low-latency wide-column store, API-compatible with Apache Cassandra and DynamoDB. This 6.x build is the final OSS line under AGPL.

name: sealed-secrets
summary: Sealed Secrets, the controller that lets you commit encrypted secrets to Git safely. A cluster-side private key decrypts SealedSecret resources into ordinary Kubernetes Secrets, so the encrypted form is the only thing that ever leaves the cluster.

name: SeaweedFS
summary: Fast distributed storage for blobs, objects, and files (S3 API) built on Facebook's Haystack design, with O(1) disk seeks for billions of small files. Default object store after MinIO restricted its community edition.

name: secrets-store-csi-driver
summary: Secrets Store CSI Driver, mounting secrets from external stores (Vault, cloud KMS) into pods as volumes, built from source.

name: selenium-node-firefox
summary: Selenium Grid 4 Firefox node, the upstream release jar with Wolfi Firefox and geckodriver, headless, on a Wolfi JRE 21. A Chromium node waits for a fixed Wolfi chromium.

name: selenium-server
summary: Selenium Grid 4 server (hub, router, distributor, session queue, event bus, node, standalone; role picked by argument), the upstream release jar on a Wolfi JRE 21.

name: shellcheck
summary: Static analysis for shell scripts. Flags quoting bugs, unsafe globbing, and portability issues in sh and bash; pipe a script in with "-" or mount a directory. Image only, no chart.

name: skopeo
summary: Skopeo, the daemonless CLI to inspect, copy, sync and delete container images between registries and storage transports. Built from source (static Go, upstream's cgo-free tag set) with the containers policy and registries config. Image only, no chart.

name: skywalking
summary: Apache SkyWalking APM — observability platform for distributed systems (distributed tracing, metrics, logs and service topology) via the OAP backend. Hardened Wolfi build of the official OAP binary distribution.

name: Solr
summary: Enterprise search platform built on Apache Lucene, offering full-text search, faceting, and indexing over large document collections.

name: sonar-scanner-cli
summary: SonarScanner CLI, the standalone scanner that analyzes a project and pushes results to a SonarQube server. Bundles its own OpenJDK. Image only, no chart.

name: spark
summary: Apache Spark, the unified batch and stream analytics engine (SQL, streaming, MLlib, Kubernetes scheduling). Built from source with the Hive and YARN profiles dropped, Jetty, Netty, Jackson and log4j floored, and the shaded Hadoop and Parquet jars rebuilt; on a Wolfi JRE 21, entrypoint compatible with the apache/spark image.

name: spicedb
summary: Zanzibar-style authorization database for fine-grained permissions over gRPC. From source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; the operator supplies the datastore (in-memory, postgres, or cockroach).

name: spire
summary: SPIRE, the SPIFFE runtime that attests nodes and workloads and issues them short-lived X.509 and JWT identities (spire-server and spire-agent in one image). Built from source; latest line only.

name: squid
summary: Caching forward proxy for HTTP and HTTPS (CONNECT). Pods reach the outside through it, and it caches repeat fetches in memory. The default config allows RFC 1918 and CGN sources and refuses CONNECT to anything but port 443. The chart supplies the config.

name: static
summary: Tiny static base for self-contained binaries from Go or Rust. Nonroot, no shell, no package manager. The only image tagged :latest.

name: step-ca
summary: Online private certificate authority and ACME server for issuing X.509 and SSH certificates. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; config and data live under a writable volume.

name: step-issuer
summary: step-issuer, smallstep's cert-manager external issuer. StepIssuer and StepClusterIssuer resources sign cert-manager CertificateRequests through a step-ca JWK provisioner. Static Go from the tagged source.

name: storm
summary: Apache Storm, a distributed real-time stream processing system; one image runs Nimbus, the supervisor, the UI and the log viewer.

name: strimzi-kafka
summary: Strimzi's Kafka image, the one the Strimzi operator runs brokers, controllers, Connect and Kafka Exporter from. Kafka with Strimzi's run scripts and agents, third-party libs, the JMX exporter and kafka_exporter, on a Wolfi JRE 21. Cruise Control is left out (its Jetty 9.4 has no fixed release).

name: strimzi-operator
summary: Strimzi, the Kubernetes operator that runs and manages Apache Kafka clusters, topics and users. One image carries the cluster operator, topic operator, user operator and kafka-init, built from the source tag with Maven on a Wolfi JRE 21.

name: support-bundle-kit
summary: Rancher's support-bundle-kit, which Longhorn and Harvester run to collect cluster objects, logs and node files into a support bundle. Built from source with upstream's node collector scripts, at the versions Longhorn pins per release line. Image only, no chart; runs as root like upstream.

name: syft
summary: Anchore's CLI for generating Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) from container images and filesystems. Image only, no chart.

name: tailscale
summary: Tailscale node (tailscaled, the tailscale CLI and containerboot), the WireGuard mesh VPN client. Upstream's container layout and TS_* environment; runs nonroot in userspace networking mode, against Tailscale or a self-hosted headscale (--login-server in TS_EXTRA_ARGS). Image only, no chart.

name: tekton
summary: Kubernetes-native CI/CD pipelines. Ships the Tekton Pipelines controller, webhook, resolvers, and pod-injected helper binaries, built from source on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: telegraf
summary: Plugin-driven agent that collects metrics, logs, and events from systems and services and writes them to time-series backends. Image only, no chart.

name: teleport
summary: Teleport (AGPL community source), the identity-based access plane for SSH, Kubernetes, databases, apps and Windows desktops. Built from source with upstream's own make full: the Rust RDP client, the IronRDP wasm module and the web UI are built and embedded, with tctl, tsh, tbot and teleport-update alongside, on current Go and patched modules.

name: Tempo
summary: Distributed tracing backend from Grafana that ingests OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, and Zipkin spans and stores them cheaply in object storage. Licensed AGPL.

name: Temporal
summary: Durable workflow orchestration engine that persists execution state so long-running, multi-step processes survive crashes and resume exactly where they left off.

name: Temporal CLI
summary: Command-line client and built-in dev server for Temporal, used to start workflows, inspect history, and run a local cluster.

name: terragrunt
summary: Terragrunt, the thin wrapper that keeps Terraform and OpenTofu configurations DRY, built from source with the 0-CVE OpenTofu build and git beside it. Newest line only (older lines carry findings that cannot be floated). Image only, no chart.

name: terralist
summary: Terralist, a private Terraform and OpenTofu registry for modules and providers (registry protocol, web UI, OAuth login, API keys). Built from source, UI included, with the vulnerable modules floated.

name: tetragon
summary: Tetragon eBPF runtime-security agent and the tetra CLI, built from source. Watches process execution, file access and network activity in the kernel, and can enforce TracingPolicies. Runs privileged on every node. cilium/ebpf and grpc are floated past 1.7.1's pins to clear CVEs.

name: tetragon-operator
summary: Tetragon's operator, which installs and maintains the TracingPolicy and PodInfo CRDs. Image only, no chart of its own; the tetragon chart deploys it.

name: thanos
summary: Highly-available Prometheus setup with unlimited metric retention via object storage, adding a global query view, downsampling, and compaction across Prometheus servers. A CNCF project.

name: tigera-operator
summary: The Tigera operator, which installs and manages Calico from an Installation resource; built from source, pinned to the Calico release the calico-* images ship.

name: tigerbeetle
summary: Distributed financial-grade accounting database for high-throughput double-entry bookkeeping. Ships a single self-contained static Zig binary; speaks its own binary protocol (not HTTP) on port 3000.

name: tika
summary: Apache Tika server, the REST API for extracting text and metadata from PDF, Office, image, archive and 1000+ other formats. The Apache 4.x release on a Wolfi openjdk-21-jre, nonroot, API on 9998.

name: timescaledb
summary: PostgreSQL 17 plus the open TimescaleDB extension (Apache-only edition), adding hypertables, continuous aggregates, and time-series functions for high-ingest metrics and event data. Built clean-licensed from source on Wolfi (no TSL community code).

name: timestamp-authority
summary: The Sigstore Timestamp Authority, an RFC 3161 timestamping server that countersigns artifact hashes, with file, KMS and Tink signers. Built from source; the default in-memory signer is for testing.

name: tomcat
summary: Apache Tomcat, the widely used open-source Java servlet container and web/application server for running Jakarta Servlet, JSP, and WebSocket web applications.

name: tomee
summary: Apache TomEE, Tomcat with the Jakarta EE Web Profile stack (OpenEJB, OpenWebBeans, MyFaces, CXF) for running Jakarta EE applications.

name: Traefik
summary: Cloud-native reverse proxy and load balancer with automatic service discovery, dynamic config, and built-in Let's Encrypt TLS.

name: trino
summary: Trino, the distributed SQL query engine for federated analytics. Assembled from upstream's release assets on Wolfi openjdk-25 with the jmx, memory, tpcds, tpch and postgresql connectors; the airlift launcher is rebuilt from source. Fault-tolerant execution and the spooling protocol (exchange-filesystem, spooling-filesystem) are left out.

name: trivy
summary: Aqua Security's all-in-one vulnerability, misconfiguration, secret, and SBOM scanner for images, filesystems, and repositories. Image only, no chart.

name: trivy-operator
summary: Trivy Operator, the Kubernetes operator that continuously scans workloads, configurations, RBAC and the cluster with Trivy and stores the results as CRDs (VulnerabilityReport, ConfigAuditReport, ...). Built from source with the coherent module floor.

name: trivy-scanner
summary: The QuenchWorks trivy build with a busybox userland, for the scan Jobs Trivy Operator launches (they run a shell command line around trivy). Image only, no chart; the trivy-operator chart uses it.

name: trufflehog
summary: TruffleHog, the secret scanner for git history, filesystems, S3, Docker images and more. Built from source (static Go) with git and ssh included for repository scans; self-update is off. Image only, no chart.

name: trust-manager
summary: trust-manager, cert-manager's trust bundle distributor. A Bundle resource gathers CA certificates from ConfigMaps, Secrets and inline PEM and writes the bundle into every selected namespace. Static Go from the tagged source.

name: tyk
summary: Full-featured API gateway with rate limiting, auth, and quotas. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; Redis is a runtime dependency the operator provides.

name: typesense
summary: Fast, typo-tolerant search engine with an instant-search REST API and a self-contained embedded store (no external database), tuned for low-latency site and in-app search.

name: unbound
summary: Unbound, the validating, recursive, caching DNS resolver from NLnet Labs. Built from source with libevent, expat and dnscrypt; a nonroot config on port 5053 with DNSSEC validation and answers for private ranges only.

name: unleash
summary: Unleash, the feature-flag and gradual-rollout server (flags, strategies, segments, environments, admin UI, client and frontend APIs) on PostgreSQL. The official npm distribution on Wolfi Node 24, two dependencies raised to fixed releases. AGPL-3.0 since 8.0.

name: uptime-kuma
summary: Uptime Kuma, the self-hosted uptime monitor and status-page server (HTTP, TCP, ping, DNS, database and more). The tagged server with pinned npm production deps and the release's prebuilt UI on Node 24; SQLite in DATA_DIR by default.

name: uv
summary: Python base image with uv, a fast Rust-based installer and resolver, used as the build stage for Python projects. Line 0.11.

name: Valkey
summary: BSD-licensed in-memory key-value store, the truly-open community fork of Redis 7.2. QuenchWorks' default cache and the recommended Redis drop-in replacement.

name: varnish
summary: HTTP reverse-proxy cache (web accelerator) that fronts an origin and serves its responses from memory, cutting backend load and tail latency. Caching policy is VCL, which varnishd compiles to native code at startup. The chart supplies the VCL and the backend.

name: vault
summary: Secrets and encryption management for tokens, keys, and certificates, with dynamic secrets, leasing, and PKI. Shipped under the Business Source License 1.1, which is not OSI-approved; OpenBao (MPL-2.0) is the open drop-in fork. Built from source with the web UI included; the chart supports multi-node raft HA. The 1.20.x line is CVE-blocked upstream and not shipped.

name: vcluster
summary: vCluster, virtual Kubernetes clusters that run inside a namespace of a host cluster. The syncer is built from source (CGO off, floated modules); the control plane it runs, kube-apiserver and kube-controller-manager 1.36.4 built from the Kubernetes tag with kine on SQLite, ships in the same image, so no initContainer copies binaries in.

name: Vector
summary: High-performance observability pipeline that collects, transforms, and routes logs, metrics, and traces between sources and sinks.

name: velero
summary: CNCF backup and disaster-recovery tool for Kubernetes cluster resources and persistent volumes. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; object-store and snapshot backends are the operator's choice.

name: velero-plugin-for-aws
summary: Velero's object-store and volume-snapshot plugin for AWS S3 and S3-compatible stores (SeaweedFS, Garage, RustFS, MinIO). Built from source; runs as an init container that copies the plugin into Velero. Image only, no chart.

name: versitygw
summary: Versity S3 Gateway, an S3-compatible API server that fronts a POSIX filesystem, another S3 service or Azure Blob, with IAM accounts and a built-in web UI. The default command serves the posix backend from /data on 7070 with a /health endpoint; root credentials come from ROOT_ACCESS_KEY and ROOT_SECRET_KEY.

name: vertical-pod-autoscaler
summary: Vertical Pod Autoscaler: the recommender, updater and admission-controller that size pod CPU and memory requests from observed usage. All three built from the kubernetes/autoscaler release tag into one image (vpa-recommender, vpa-updater, vpa-admission-controller), nonroot.

name: victorialogs
summary: Fast, cost-efficient logs database with the LogsQL query language. Single static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; log data lives on a writable volume.

name: VictoriaMetrics
summary: Fast, cost-efficient time-series database that speaks PromQL and Prometheus remote_write. Drop-in long-term storage or full replacement for Prometheus.

name: vikunja
summary: Self-hosted to-do and project management app (lists, kanban, gantt, calendar) serving both the API and the Vue web UI. From source with the UI embedded on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; SQLite or an external SQL database.

name: vitess
summary: Horizontal sharding, connection pooling and failover for MySQL. Ships the core command set as one image (vtgate, vttablet, vtctld, vtctldclient, vtorc, mysqlctl, mysqlctld, vtbackup) as static Go binaries on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; a deployment picks its component by overriding the command. Image only, no chart.

name: vllm
summary: vLLM, the high-throughput LLM inference and serving engine with an OpenAI-compatible API. CPU build — installs vLLM's prebuilt CPU wheel (torch+cpu, no source compile, no CUDA) into a venv on a hardened Wolfi python-3.12 base, 0-CVE across ~140 Python packages. The user supplies the model; the chart runs it as a StatefulSet with a persistent model cache.

name: weaviate
summary: Open-source AI-native vector database for semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation, with hybrid keyword plus vector queries.

name: wildfly
summary: WildFly, the Jakarta EE application server, on a Wolfi openjdk-21 JRE. Nonroot, read-only rootfs (all runtime writes under /tmp), HTTP on 8080 and management on loopback. Its bundled OpenTelemetry family is moved to 1.62.0 for a CVE, with each module descriptor rewritten to match.

name: wiremock
summary: WireMock, the HTTP API mock server (stubs, response templating, proxying and recording, fault injection, request journal, admin API) on Jetty 12. Assembled from its unshaded Maven artifacts with vulnerable families pinned, on a Wolfi JRE 21.

name: woodpecker
summary: Lightweight, container-native CI/CD engine (a Drone-compatible fork) with a server, agent, and CLI. From source (Vue UI embedded in the static Go server) on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base.

name: wordpress
summary: WordPress, the PHP content-management system and blogging platform. Reconstructed clean-room from the official release on a hardened Wolfi php-8.4-fpm + nginx runtime (nonroot, read-only rootfs, supervisord), not the php:apache upstream image. The image ships no wp-config.php; the chart supplies one via ConfigMap and provides a MySQL backend.

name: xyops
summary: xyops, a workflow-automation and server-monitoring system (job scheduler, monitors, alerting, ticketing) by the creator of Cronicle. Built from source on Wolfi nodejs-22 (native better-sqlite3), nonroot on a hardened read-only-rootfs base. Single-instance with an embedded SQLite store on a persistent volume; the chart runs it as a StatefulSet.

name: yarn
summary: Node base image with Yarn preinstalled, used as the build stage for Yarn projects. Lines 1 (classic) and 4 (berry).

name: yourls
summary: YOURLS, the self-hosted URL shortener with click stats, an admin UI and an API. The release tarball on Wolfi php-fpm behind QuenchWorks nginx (8080), configured entirely from YOURLS_* environment variables; needs MySQL or MariaDB.

name: zabbix-server
summary: Zabbix server, the collector and alerting engine of the Zabbix monitoring platform, built from source with the PostgreSQL backend. Ships the database schema under /usr/share/zabbix. SNMP checks are not included (Wolfi net-snmp has no MD5).

name: zabbix-web
summary: Zabbix web frontend (PHP) on nginx and php-fpm, PostgreSQL backend, configured from ZBX_DB_* environment variables. Pairs with zabbix-server of the same version.

name: zipkin
summary: Zipkin, the distributed tracing server (HTTP, gRPC, Kafka, RabbitMQ and ActiveMQ collection, the query API and the Lens UI on 9411). The official exec jar with 66 library jars swapped to fixed releases; the legacy Pulsar and Scribe collectors are removed.

name: zitadel
summary: Cloud-native identity and access management (IAM) with OIDC/OAuth2/SAML, multi-tenancy, and a built-in admin console. Packaged from ZITADEL's official prebuilt binary; event-sourced store on an external PostgreSQL.

name: ZooKeeper
summary: Centralized coordination service for distributed systems, providing configuration, naming, leader election, and synchronization primitives.

name: zot
summary: OCI-native container registry (registry, sync, and dist-spec surface). Built from source as a static Go binary on a hardened nonroot Wolfi base; filesystem storage under a writable volume.

name: ztunnel
summary: Istio's ambient-mode node proxy (ztunnel, Rust), built from source from the istio/ztunnel tags on the same three lines as istiod, with aws-lc TLS and jemalloc as upstream builds it, over Wolfi iptables.
